findings.trigger: Apply delivered patch to exact base app tree.
findings.expected: Canonical valid app paths; clean check and replacement agreement.
findings.observed: Out-of-repository exact archive and canonical unchanged-app read-only checks both exit 128: invalid concatenated canonical/delivery path. Patch not applied.

findings.observed: safeParse fails on missing paused. PreferencesStore performs an ad hoc repair, but direct schema/type consumers remain incompatible.

findings.observed: getStorage swallows getter failure as null without marking denied; subsequent constructor starts defaults. First true, second false.
WorldRoot passes neither initialPaused nor initial setDecorativePaused. Runtime defaults false despite controller paused true; constructor property diagnostic reproduces mismatch before rendering.
findings.scope: source + constructor state diagnostic; rendered path NOT RUN

findings.trigger: Request painting preset while paused; advance 180 frames.
findings.expected: Bounded requested spring safely settles without clearing pause.
findings.observed: Paused branch advances only greeting; painting remains 5.5 degrees and unsettled after 3 seconds.

findings.expected: Only complete same-representation aggregate can be determinate.
findings.observed: Emits required-session 4/4 (100%) with only 1 of 3 requests started; no aggregate denominators. EOF short body 2/header4 never diagnoses mismatch; body-null fallback actual2 emits fabricated4/4.

findings.trigger: New required bytes at t=10s; clock reaches15s, or stale entrance call during current loading.
findings.expected: Fail only after15s without new required high-water/decode/integration; stale calls cannot clear current timer.
findings.observed: New required progress still fails at absolute15s. startEntrance(oldToken) returns false but clears timer; genuine stall stays LOADING with zero timers.

findings.trigger: Recreate WorldRuntime/LifecycleManager or supply same-token progress from another generation.
findings.expected: Unique monotonically increasing runtime generation plus token fence.
findings.observed: Runtime omits sessionGeneration; loader defaults1. New manager also starts1. updateLoadingProgress accepts generation999 with token1. Runtime optional callback checks only token and disposed flag.

findings.trigger: Two concurrent loadSession calls on one loader have limits2 and0.
findings.expected: Each session owns its retry policy.
findings.observed: Second session overwrites this.maxRetries; first stops after its first failed attempt. Total requests2 instead of4 (3 first-session attempts plus1 second-session attempt).

findings.trigger: Synchronous optional consumer throws, or returns adopted then loader aborts.
findings.expected: Throw/reject immediately releases once; successful adoption removes loader ownership.
findings.observed: Throw bypasses disposeTexture: zero disposals before abort. Adopted deskmat/wallpaper each disposed by loader abort. unregister APIs are unused; runtime separately disposes adopted list and material maps.
findings.evidence: consumer-throw and adopted-abort in observations.jsonl; source: WorldRuntime.ts:672-680,724-769

findings.trigger: Optional texture resolves before integration, target is absent, or consumer step throws.
findings.expected: Typed deskmat/wallpaper buffering, validated target, atomic material/quality/list rollback.
findings.observed: Push happens before apply; missing integrated scene/target returns void and callback still adopted. Buffer is Texture[]; replay applies every entry to both targets, so target identity is lost. No rollback restores list/maps/quality.
findings.scope: source inspection; full adoption rollback/browser NOT RUN

findings.trigger: Register GLTF then prune nodes, or share resources across meshes; GLTF material has map/ImageBitmap.
findings.expected: Capture complete identities before prune and dispose each geometry/material/texture/bitmap once.
findings.observed: Only GLTF root is retained; detached resources get0 disposals. Shared geometry/material disposed2 times. GLTF map texture and bitmap get0 disposals/close calls; geometry/material Sets never populated.
findings.evidence: shared-disposal, pruned-disposal, bitmap-disposal in observations.jsonl; SceneIntegrator.ts:67,87

findings.trigger: Late deskmat while LOW, shared target material, or nonexact mutable name.
findings.expected: Owned original map plus current derivative refresh; isolation, sRGB and consistent batch exclusions.
findings.observed: LOW and HIGH both retain old map after adoption/roundtrip. Shared unrelated mesh receives new map. New texture colorSpace remains empty. desk_mat_overlay matches runtime but is batched and original hidden because batch regex is exact.
findings.evidence: late-map-roundtrip, shared-late-material, late-colorspace, batch-name-match in observations.jsonl
